disclosure: Muse Wonder, a Meta model, wrote these sentences from each card. We asked it to slip mistakes into some.

rounds.title: A cafe on Tuesday
rounds.why: The card says 26 morning coffees; the sentence says 26.

rounds.title: A bookshop this week
rounds.why: The card says 42 novels shelved; the sentence says 45.

rounds.title: City weather this week
rounds.why: The card says 4 sunny days; the sentence says 4.

rounds.title: A football club this season
rounds.sentence: The club had 9 home wins last season.
rounds.why: The card is for this season; the sentence puts 9 home wins last season.
rounds.checker_note: The checker only compares numbers here and cannot see time windows.

rounds.title: A bakery on Saturday
rounds.sentence: The bakery did not sell 12 croissants.
rounds.why: The card says 12 croissants; the sentence says it did not sell 12.
rounds.checker_note: The checker catches the "not" because it cannot prove a "did not" sentence from the card.

rounds.title: A school concert on Friday
rounds.why: The card says 18 songs sung; the sentence says 17.
